about: Record values turned into words video and picture models follow (blueprint 8.3; C3 §4-§8, §12, §16; B1 §15; D15; D12). The compiler builds every prompt from these phrases and the records; nothing here is a reason, a mood word or a name.

size.marks: V C3 §4 (shot sizes reliable on top models [P1][P43]); B1 §15

frame.pov: seen through {whose} eyes, {anchor} in the foreground
frame.marks: V C3 §4 (over-the-shoulder naming the shoulder; POV with a visible anchor) [P1][P34]

angle.worms_eye: from the floor, looking straight up
angle.marks: V C3 §4 (low, high, overhead mostly reliable) [P1][P43]; B1 §15

move.static: Static shot. The camera does not move.
move.pan: The camera pans {direction}, slowly, ending on {end}.
move.tilt: The camera tilts {direction}, slowly, ending on {end}.
move.push_in: The camera pushes in slowly, ending on {end}.
move.pull_back: The camera pulls back slowly to reveal {end}.
move.sideways: The camera slides sideways, parallel to {subject}, ending on {end}.
move.rise: The camera rises slowly, ending on {end}.
move.lower: The camera lowers slowly, ending on {end}.
move.follow: The camera tracks alongside {subject}, keeping the same distance.
move.lead: The camera moves backward ahead of {subject}, keeping the same distance.
move.crane: The camera cranes {direction}, slowly, ending on {end}.
move.orbit: The camera makes a slow half-circle around {subject}.
move.zoom: The camera moves slowly closer to {subject}.

never_in_words.dolly_zoom: use a guide video from a grey preview (C3 §4, §9D)
never_in_words.rack_focus: split into two shots or composite (B1 R14; C3 §4)

move.marks: V C3 §4 and its rules 1-4 [P1][P11][P34][P44]; B1 §15; 'usually works' moves get one extra take (C3 §4 [J]); zoom is unreliable as a distinct move (J)

lens.note: a lens in millimetres is never written; its effect is ("85 mm" becomes "compressed background")
lens.marks: V blueprint 8.1 (camera row); C3 §4 (focal lengths U) [P11]; words.json prompt_substitutions

placement.left_edge: at the left edge of the frame
placement.left_third: on the left third of the frame
placement.centre: in the centre of the frame
placement.right_third: on the right third of the frame
placement.right_edge: at the right edge of the frame
placement.marks: V blueprint 8.1 (subjects row: 'on the left third of the image, facing right')

facing.marks: V blueprint 8.1; C3 L25 (sides and facing in dialogue shots)

side.frame_left: on the left of the frame
side.frame_right: on the right of the frame
side.nearest the camera: on the hand nearest the camera
side.marks: V C1 R22, Ex3; C2 Rule 35 (left and right in image terms)

travel.frame_left: {who} moves toward the left edge of the frame.
travel.frame_right: {who} moves toward the right edge of the frame.

display.marks: V blueprint 8.1 (subjects row: the display level as the size of the visible behaviour); D15 §2; 10 October 2026: level 1 no longer says 'contained' (Project notes 42: words about holding back read as an order to freeze); H3 prompts leave the display sentence out (J)

must_not.marks: V blueprint 8.1 rule 9 ('He does not look at her.'); D15 (must-not never written as 'no X')

negation_rewrites.about: Negation of a visible thing makes models show it (C3 L14). Code turns the records' negations into the allowed forms before a prompt is written: 'does not <verb>' for a behaviour held back (8.1 rule 9), positive words elsewhere; a sentence it cannot turn is left out of the prompt and listed on the pack page.

patterns.note: a held-back behaviour in the present
a contrast clause ("watches the leaf, not the women") is left out; the positive part stays
'asks it without looking up' becomes 'asks it and does not look up'

negation_rewrites.marks: V C3 L14, §8 rules; blueprint 8.1 rule 9; the patterns are J

glass.clear: seen through perfectly clear glass; the room on the camera's side is dark
glass.marked: soft, unreadable highlights lie on the glass
glass.reflecting: a clear reflection lies on the glass, the reflected side lit brighter than the far side
glass.screen: the glass carries a dark, blank screen
glass.broken_open: the glass is broken open, jagged at the edges
glass.marks: V blueprint 8.1 rule 6 and K18 (clear); B3 R28-R29 and C2 §6 (reflecting, marked) are J wordings

physics.weightless: hair, cloth and straps drift up and outward; nothing settles
physics.camera_on_the_moving_thing: The camera is fixed to {thing} and does not move relative to it.
physics.world_moving: beyond it, the world streams past, faster and faster
physics.rule: never write 'falling' or 'zero gravity' alone: write the visible evidence (C3 R13, L23)

text.screen_dark: the screen is dark and blank, switched off
text.screen_green: the screen is a flat, evenly lit, pure bright green panel, matte, not glowing; its corners stay clear
text.marks: V blueprint 8.1 (TEXT_ON_SCREEN always none: 'plain, unmarked surfaces'); K17; D12 §6

people.start_picture_names: with a start picture, people are 'the woman', 'the man' (C3 R1); several of one kind are told apart by their place in the frame

audio.off_screen_voice: {who}'s voice is heard, {path}; {pronoun} is not visible.

paths.earpiece: heard only in an earpiece, thin and close
paths.radio: through a small radio speaker, narrow and crackly
paths.intercom: through a small intercom speaker, slightly thin
paths.recording: as a recording from a small speaker
paths.helmet_inside: inside a helmet, close and dry
paths.voice_over: as a voice over the picture
paths.thought: as a voice over the picture

audio.marks: V C3 §7E-§7F, R10, R21 [P1][P6][P8][P26][P31]; K31 (no music in any clip); MiniMax's reference-mode guide writes non_diegetic_music: N/A when there is no music (V, checked 2026-10-10)

end_picture.lead: It ends exactly on the closing picture.

guide_video.lead: Camera movement, pacing and blocking come from the guide video; follow it exactly.
guide_video.seedance: Refer to {tag} for camera movement, pacing, shot-size transitions, subject trajectory, and blocking.

delivery_rewrites.note: a delivery with any other negation is replaced by the speaker's tactic in the shot (C3 L14)
delivery_rewrites.marks: J from C3 L14 and §7B (tone words for the voice only)

check_questions.face: Is {name}'s face as readable and as true in colour as the other faces in this frame?
check_questions.same_face: Is it the same face as {name}'s reference pictures?
check_questions.mouth: Does only {whose} mouth move for the line, and only at {t0} to {t1} seconds?
check_questions.no_music: Is there no music and no other voice?
check_questions.camera_holds: Does the camera hold its framing, with no drift or zoom?
check_questions.text_blank: Are the surfaces blank, with no letters?
check_questions.one_take: Is it one continuous take, with no cut inside it?
check_questions.moves_between: Does {name} move between the written actions: breathing, eyes, small shifts?
check_questions.said_once: Is each line said once, by the right mouth?
check_questions.cut_lands: Does each cut land within about a second of its written time?
check_questions.tail_left_out: Is the tail, after second {seconds}, left out of the kept part?
check_questions.contact_across_cut: Does the hit happen across the cut, never on screen?
check_questions.actions_in_order: Do these happen, in this order: {actions}?
check_questions.same_faces: Are the faces the same as your pictures of {names}?
check_questions.keep_moving: Do {names} keep moving between the written actions: breathing, eyes, small shifts?
check_questions.camera_moves: Does the camera make its one move ({move}) smoothly, and stop where the shot ends?
check_questions.marks: V blueprint 8.9 (yes/no questions built from the records; B2 R24 for the face question); C1 Rec11; 10 October 2026 (Project notes 42, W10): no question asks whether something stays still; the questions ask about the failures testers found (J); 10 October 2026 (Project notes 43, round 2, N14 and N15): a clip's questions open with its own actions and end, ask about everyone once, and check a moving camera (J)

text_graphics.mirror: the mirrored copy wraps everything in <g transform="translate(W,0) scale(-1,1)"> ... </g> (a bare scale(-1,1) leaves a blank picture)
text_graphics.marks: V D12 §4 Rec7 (title card: 1920 x 804, Plex Medium, #EDEBE6 on black), R6-R7 (cap heights 4%, 2.5-3%, under 1.5%), R17 (non-story graphics never mirrored); C2 R6 (mirror transform); fonts and licences V D12 §7; the sign and screen sizes and the other canvases are J

h3.camera_sentence: The shot is static, on a tripod, with no camera movement whatsoever.
h3.marks: J h3-storyboard testing notes: the one camera line that holds; a second camera line made cuts drift
